name: concord
description: Stay in control while AI agents write your code. A strong model turns each task into a short plan you approve, writes the tests and the small changes, and checks every result; low-cost models implement the bulky phases inside a fixed file scope, against tests that must fail first; an independent reviewer checks each change once at its risk level; you review the diff and commit. Adds /concord:plan-then-delegate, /concord:delegate and /concord:rules-review, plus implementer and reviewer agents. Needs the dispatcher from the repository's install.sh. Actively developed: new versions ship through this marketplace.
